text: Made like any MPC: pasteurised skim milk is ultrafiltered and the retentate evaporated and spray dried. About 70 % protein is roughly where plain ultrafiltration stops being enough and diafiltration (water added to wash lactose out) comes in; see the mpc and MPC80 entries for the membrane and diafiltration facts.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: Whole milk is first split into cream and skim milk.
Lactose, minerals and water pass through the membrane while casein and whey proteins are held back.
Evaporation concentrates the retained liquid further.
The concentrate is spray dried to a powder.

sources.text: The order of separating, ultrafiltering, evaporating and spray drying is from this article; it gives no figures, and does not say how the 70 % grade is reached.
